description: GET /users/:id renames the response field userId (number) to id (string) and drops the email field without versioning, silently breaking all existing clients that read userId or email from this endpoint.
The GET /users/:id response now includes passwordHash, leaking an internal credential field to API consumers and any client that logs responses.
GET /users changes from returning a top-level array to wrapping it in {data: [...]}, breaking clients that call .map() or iterate the response directly.
